consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly agree that the 1982-10-17 show at Santa Fe Downs is one of the best performances of the year, showcasing exceptional energy and musicianship. Many highlight the strong vocals from Jerry Garcia and the overall vibe of the concert as uplifting and memorable.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 24 reviews + 1.5 sentiment: The high praise and enthusiasm from multiple reviewers indicate a strong positive sentiment towards the performance.
